gaps.sentence: The bank agreed to ___ him the money.
gaps.hint: meaning: give temporarily (from the giver's point of view)
gaps.explanation: 'Lend' means to give something to someone temporarily; the bank lends money. A base verb is needed after 'to'.

gaps.hint: past participle after 'have'; the verb takes no object
gaps.explanation: 'Rise' (rise, rose, risen) takes no object: sales have risen. 'Raise' takes an object: they raised prices.

gaps.hint: the uncountable activity of travelling in general
gaps.explanation: 'Travel' is uncountable when it means travelling in general; the other options are countable nouns.

gaps.sentence: The medicine had an immediate ___ on her pain.
gaps.hint: a noun is needed after 'an immediate'
gaps.explanation: 'Effect' is the noun meaning result; the fixed phrase is 'have an effect on something'.
'Complement' means to combine well with or complete something; 'compliment' means to praise.

gaps.sentence: He is very ___ to criticism and takes it personally.
gaps.hint: easily affected or hurt; pattern: ___ to
gaps.explanation: 'Sensitive to something' means easily affected or upset by it; 'sensible' means showing good judgement.

gaps.sentence: The new law will ___ every driver in the country.
gaps.explanation: 'Affect' is the verb meaning to have an influence on; 'effect' is normally a noun meaning a result.

gaps.sentence: It would be ___ to take an umbrella — the sky is black.
gaps.explanation: 'Sensible' means showing good judgement; 'sensitive' means easily affected by things or feelings.
